# Quantum Arc

> Quantum Arc builds websites and automation for small businesses — fast, credible, and priced simply, with no agency overhead.

Quantum Arc is an independent software studio based in Michigan, run directly by the person who builds the work — no salespeople, account managers, or outsourced developers in between. Services: website design and development, ongoing website maintenance, and small business automation (lead handling, notifications, spreadsheet/report automation, tool integrations).

## Pages

- [Home](https://quantumarc.net/): Overview, services, pricing, portfolio, and contact.
- [Blog](https://quantumarc.net/blog): Articles on websites, small business marketing, and automation.

## Pricing

- Starter Website — from $650 (up to 5 pages, mobile-friendly, contact form, basic SEO)
- Business Website — from $950 (up to 10 pages, blog/content section, lead forms, analytics)
- Website Care — $49/month (uptime monitoring, backups, security monitoring, minor content updates)
- Business Automation — from $250 (lead/email automation, spreadsheet/report automation, integrations)
